solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Plant's given water by this person outside front of shed

indicators.note: the two pieces for water and this person sit around the shed's first letter

parts.note: the sea is a body of water

indicators.note: the front of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: the setter referring to themself, so ME

explanation.surface: A gardener says they water a plant standing just outside the shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' has the water and this-person pieces enclose the shed's first letter; 's given is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Sesame is an annual plant grown for its oily seeds.

clue.text: Animation coming with first-half upset not immediately obvious?

indicators.note: only the first half of the synonym is turned round, the rest left as it stands

parts.note: bustle means lively activity or animation

explanation.surface: A cartoon appearing with a disrupted first half is hard to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' turns the first half BUS into SUB, leaving TLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something subtle is delicate or understated, so its meaning is not grasped at once.

clue.text: Gets rid of sounds in smooth-running vehicles

indicators.note: the clue word sounds signals a word heard rather than seen

parts.note: slays means kills, gets rid of

explanation.surface: Someone disposes of noises in quiet-running cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Sledges glide easily over snow on runners, so they run smoothly.

clue.text: Holy vessel that could be fashioned by Normans, etc

indicators.note: the letters could be fashioned, that is reshaped, into the answer

explanation.surface: A sacred container that Norman craftsmen and others might have made.
explanation.definitionFit: In Catholic worship, the consecrated host is displayed in an ornate open receptacle.

clue.text: Yon church man covered with traditional roof material

parts.note: yon is an old word for that, pointing at something distant
Ed is a man's name, short for Edward

explanation.surface: Over there, a churchman is seen under a traditional roof covering.
explanation.definitionFit: Thatch is straw or reed laid as roofing, so a cottage with such a roof is described this way.

clue.text: Delays one found in the likes of Paddington, explosive having been found earlier

indicators.note: the explosive piece comes before the rest

parts.note: HE stands for high explosive

indicators.note: the numeral is placed inside the word for places like Paddington

parts.note: Paddington is a London railway terminus, one of many stations
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Holdups at London's Paddington and similar spots after a bomb was found.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found in' puts I in STATIONS after the first S. Paddington wants to be the bear but is the London railway station.
explanation.definitionFit: Hesitations are pauses or moments of indecision that hold things up.

clue.text: Neat edging at bottom of garment

definitions.meaning: tidy and in good order, an adjective
a decorative border or trimming sewn onto clothes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means tidy as an adjective and decorative border as a noun.

clue.text: In kitchen ban every poison

indicators.note: the letters are found in a run across the three words

explanation.surface: A household rule forbidding all toxic substances in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Henbane is a toxic nightshade plant used historically as a poison.

clue.text: Fighter that ought to be paid still in action

parts.note: a debt that is owing is due

indicators.note: the letters of still are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: A combatant who is owed wages is still fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: One who fights formal one-to-one combats with swords or pistols is a combatant.

clue.text: Hill hiding lake that provides fish

indicators.note: the comedian's first name contains the lake's letter tucked away inside it

parts.note: Benny Hill was a British TV comedian, so his first name partners Hill
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A hill concealing a lake that supplies fish to anglers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hill' looks like a landform but is the surname of Benny Hill, a famous British TV comedian.
explanation.definitionFit: Blennies are small spiny-finned sea creatures found in rock pools, a kind of fish.

clue.text: One receiving property sees gain after transfer

indicators.note: letters that have been transferred about are moved into new positions

explanation.surface: A beneficiary who sees a gain once some property is transferred to them.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, the party to whom rights or property are assigned is the recipient of that transfer.

clue.text: Say one tiny fellow comes in after time? It's OK

indicators.note: the group of pieces goes into the word meaning after time

parts.note: something late arrives after the appointed time
say means for example, abbreviated EG
the Roman numeral for one is I
Tiny Tim is the small boy in Dickens's A Christmas Carol

explanation.surface: A little man arrives late and asks whether that's all right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes in' sends the three pieces inside the word for after time. Tiny Tim is the boy in Dickens's A Christmas Carol; 'It's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something OK in the sense of allowed or above board is lawful and acceptable.

clue.text: Doctor on boat is someone who's got an extra job

definitions.text: someone who's got an extra job

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
a lighter is a flat-bottomed barge for loading ships

explanation.surface: A medic aboard a vessel is working a second job.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonlighting is taking secret extra work besides one's main employment.

clue.text: Ring accepted by hysterical lover

indicators.note: the run of letters is taken in by the two words that follow

explanation.surface: A phone ring is answered by an overwrought sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring someone is to phone them, so the noun ring is a telephone contact.

clue.text: It's wrong to show lack of respect to Her Majesty, an immoral habit

parts.note: to diss someone is slang for disrespecting them
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen
a vice is an immoral habit

explanation.surface: Disrespecting the Queen counts as a sinful habit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' is a link; ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A disservice is a harmful act or an injury done to someone, a wrong.

clue.text: New air hostess flying shows quality needed during one sort of journey

definitions.text: quality needed during one sort of journey

indicators.note: letters flying about are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A newly hired flight attendant reveals a skill needed for travelling.
explanation.walkthrough: The air hostess suggests a flight, but the journey meant is by sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel fit for a sea voyage has the property of being safe on open water.

clue.text: A Conservative minister telling it like it is

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative in British politics
a curate is a junior minister of the church

explanation.surface: A Tory government minister being frank and honest.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking truthfully and precisely, without distortion, is being correct and exact.

clue.text: Rented accommodation in which mad cousin Chloe entertains us

indicators.note: to entertain guests is to have them inside, so the scrambled names hold the word us
the letters of the two words go wild and are rearranged

explanation.surface: An eccentric relative named Chloe has us to stay in her rented home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mad' scrambles the two names and 'entertains' holds us within them. A council house is British social housing rented from a local authority.
explanation.definitionFit: Local-authority dwellings in Britain are let to tenants at subsidised rents.

clue.text: A rude GP out to improve

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of their order

explanation.surface: An impolite family doctor is pushed out to raise standards.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise to a higher standard or level is to make better.

clue.text: One may be up the mountains making jump with shout of approval

definitions.text: One may be up the mountains

parts.note: to skip is to hop or jump lightly
ole is the Spanish cry of approval, as at a bullfight

explanation.surface: A climber high in the mountains jumps and cheers.
explanation.definitionFit: Skiers carry a pair of these sticks for balance on alpine slopes.

clue.text: Stones put up to support cooker

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits below and supports the cooker

parts.note: an Aga is a British range cooker

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: to set something is to put it down

explanation.surface: Bricks are placed to hold up a stove.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses SET to TES, beneath AGA. An Aga is a heavy cast-iron British range cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: Agates are banded semi-precious stones of chalcedony.

clue.text: Press wants removal of undesirables first off

indicators.note: the opening letter of the synonym is taken away

parts.note: a purge is a clearing out of unwanted people

explanation.surface: Newspapers call for a clear-out of unwanted people to begin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first off' removes the P of PURGE.
explanation.definitionFit: To press someone is to push or encourage them strongly, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Refusing to change when energy is limited — a vain exercise of modern times?

definitions.text: a vain exercise of modern times?

indicators.note: the energy synonym is held within the bounds of the rearranged letters
the word Refusing must change its letter order

parts.note: go means energy or vigour, as in full of go

explanation.surface: Declining to alter one's habits when short of energy, a pointless modern pastime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to change' scrambles Refusing and 'is limited' encloses the energy word within it, just after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Searching the internet for mentions of your own name is a vanity of the web era.

clue.text: Female member in agricultural business

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A woman joins the staff of an agricultural enterprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm is an enterprise growing crops or raising livestock for a living.

clue.text: Unrestricted in restaurant choice, Clara ate stew

indicators.note: a stew mixes its ingredients together, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A diner named Clara, free to choose anything, ordered stew.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordering dish by dish from the menu, rather than a set meal, gives free choice.

clue.text: To eat a lot may be very good, but disease ensues

indicators.note: the disease follows after the first piece

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is crossword shorthand for very good
gout is a painful joint disease linked with rich eating

explanation.surface: Feasting may feel great, but gout follows afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to gorge or stuff yourself with food is a verb phrase for overindulging.

clue.text: What the increasingly greedy want unceasingly

definitions.meaning: read as two words, the greedy keep wanting still more

explanation.definitionFit: As one word it means forever; split in two it is the demand of the insatiable.

clue.text: Goddess shown on the outside of uranium plant

indicators.note: the goddess's name wraps around the element symbol

parts.note: Ceres is the Roman goddess of agriculture
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A goddess is depicted surrounding a uranium-laden plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Cereus is a genus of cactus, so it names a kind of plant.
